'''Savatte''' was a [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] member of the [[Bahk-tov Council/Legends|Bahk-tov Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
When [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] warned the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to assist with the threat of its [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]] Savatte sat in the council.

After Julia was kidnapped by the sect, Savatte led [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to the catacombs of an ancient [[temple]] where a shrine was built by the Frangawl where the [[Demon/Legends|demon]] [[Malmourral/Legends|Malmourral]] was worshiped. The Bardottan gave Windu's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] back, even though he hoped he would not have to use the weapon. After Jar Jar was kidnapped in the catacombs, Mace sent Savatte back to the Council to report on what happened.
